note: Pins for external binaries used by the feasibility spike. sha256 stays null until the exact release artifact is downloaded and verified; a null sha256 fails the prerequisite check on purpose so a build never trusts an unverified jar.

otp.release_commit_verified: confirmed via GitHub API: v2.9.0 tag -> annotated tag object -> commit 9babe45ffc9327933129f705c648137ecd96cdbe, 2026-09-16
otp.sha256_provenance: self-computed at download time; file size (183261367 bytes) matches the GitHub release asset metadata. OTP publishes a detached GPG signature (otp-shaded-2.9.0.jar.asc), not a plain checksum file, so this pin guards local corruption/tampering, not a compromised upstream release.

gtfs_validator.sha256_provenance: self-computed at download time; MobilityData does not publish an independent checksum file for this release, so this pin only guards against local corruption/tampering after first download, not against a compromised upstream release

osm_extract.note: Small overlapping OSM PBF extract for the synthetic smoke network's street data. Reuse an appropriately licensed existing OTP test fixture rather than building a road graph. Treated as soft-optional in the CLI: its absence does not block the smoke chain, but any case needing real street topology (false_transfer_across_barrier) is not meaningfully validated without it. Not yet obtained.
